Skeletal muscle repair depends on coordinated changes in cell state and metabolism. We investigate
how metabolic regulation influences the transition from stem-cell activation to differentiation,
and how these processes become disrupted during atrophy and aging.

## From mechanism to function

Cell and bioengineered-tissue models are combined with metabolomics, lipidomics, imaging and
functional phenotyping. This allows molecular pathways to be evaluated in relation to regenerative
capacity and muscle performance.
